evidence: Touches test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py, which verifies p2p transaction relay rules to block-relay-only peers.
rationale: Fixes a vacuous test assertion in `p2p_blocksonly.py` where announcements were verified using txid instead of wtxid under wtxidrelay.
